stemMd: A recessive trait appears only in individuals with genotype aa. Two unaffected heterozygous parents have a child. What is the probability that this child has the trait?
explanationMd: Each heterozygous parent transmits a with probability one half. The child must receive a from both parents, so multiply one half by one half to obtain one quarter. The four equally likely combinations are AA, Aa, aA and aa; only the last is affected.

distractorRationale.c: This is the probability of a heterozygous child, not an affected child.
distractorRationale.d: This is the probability of an unaffected phenotype.
distractorRationale.a: Both parents can pass on the recessive allele.
distractorRationale.e: The parents can also pass on the dominant allele.
